title: Enable network lifecycle dispatcher providers
summary: Adds desktop-owned Coordinator/Worker lifecycle providers so confirmed Network Lifecycle Start/Stop commands can construct and stop the real coordinator and worker dispatchers instead of permanently failing provider preconditions.
reason: The deployed portable build showed the hardened Network page and route controls, but Start Worker/Start Coordinator still returned a backend precondition block because request_network_lifecycle only saw monkeypatched test providers and no real app/service provider existed. The worker screenshot also showed a bind-all coordinator address being used as a worker connect URL, so worker URL preflight now blocks that before provider startup.
behavior_before: Network lifecycle routes were registered and fail-closed, but confirmed start could not start coordinator or worker runtime because no start_network_coordinator/start_network_worker provider existed. Worker settings such as http://0.0.0.0:7830 were not rejected until provider/runtime validation.
behavior_after: The application facade exposes desktop-owned lifecycle providers that start/stop CoordinatorDispatcher and WorkerDispatcher through request_network_lifecycle only. Claimed worker jobs launch as backend single-file pipeline work without enabling normal Launch in network modes, journal failure after start attempts triggers provider cleanup, and malformed/bind-all worker coordinator URLs block during preflight.
